target_customer: Vacation rental property management companies with 20 or more units and a property management system
problem: Short-term rental operations run across fragmented tools for guest messages, cleaning, maintenance, vendors and owner updates, needing large human teams.
business_model: B2B SaaS, single plan scaling with property count
product_category: AI agents for short-term rental operations

founders.name: Lodovico Benvenuti
previous_startups: Property management company scaled to about $2M revenue and 150+ listings (name not given)
founders.background_notes: Built AI customer service agents for short-term rentals at Conduit per YC page.

founders.name: Jan Sahagun
prior_employers: STR Tech Report (built the media platform)
founders.background_notes: Former hockey player turned sales; YC page says he closed $2M worldwide in about two years in STR tech.

competitors.name: Guesty AI agents
competitors.what: Property management system adding AI agent platform across guest communication, operations, finance and reviews, with ReplyAI Autopilot in 2026-04

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents across 200+ integrations and operations workflows with escalation controls are standard engineering with hard reliability parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with PMS partners (certified on Guesty and Hostaway) add stickiness, but PMS vendors are shipping their own agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Guesty launched its own AI agent platform in 2026-06, soon after the Trellis batch.

market_need_then: Hostaway reported over 70% of vacation rental managers use AI tools in some form, while a 2026-06 poll found only 7% had reached autonomous agents, indicating room for end to end agents.

identity.voice_and_tone: Punchy: 'Vacation rentals ran on chaos. Now they run on agents.'

branding.brand_signature: The 'ran on chaos, now run on agents' line.
branding.community_and_virality: Listed on Guesty, Hostaway and Hospitable marketplaces and sponsoring IMN's STR forum; co-founder interviews in trade events.

brand_strength.rationale: Visible in industry marketplaces and events, but the name is shared by many companies named Trellis.

outcome_analysis: Trellis, a Spring 2026 YC company, reports fast growth from founders with short-term rental experience (self reported $500k to $614k ARR within about two months). No shutdown found as of November 2026. The main risk is PMS platforms like Guesty shipping their own agents.
notes: Funding conflicts: Dealroom $125k seed, FundedIQ $500k pre-seed 2026-06, VCBacked pre-seed 2026-06 no amount; all aggregators, no round recorded. ARR figures are self reported ($500k sponsor profile, over $600k job posting, $614k ARR.club). The YC page says 100+ customers and 20,000+ listings while the YC description says 35 customers and 3000 listings, likely different dates. Education of both founders not found. Rounds rest on single databases each (FundedIQ 500K pre-seed June 2026; Dealroom 125K seed, undated); they may be the same financing and conflict. Crunchbase lists only the pre-seed stage.
